name: webide-hx (all-in-one)
description: A Haxe development environment in the browser: editor, compiler and the running app, with hot reload and a debugger. Everything inside the extension; nothing hosted.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' blob:; worker-src blob:; child-src blob:; default-src 'self' blob: data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; media-src 'self' blob: data:; connect-src 'self' blob: data: https: http:
